_about: Illustrative guidance for the Road Desk agent, not workshop advice. A trouble code is a signal from the car's computer, not a diagnosis. The agent uses this to decide what to ask the driver and how urgent the case is; the car owner (the customer) decides repairs and recovery. Severity: STOP_NOW = stop as soon as it is safe and do not drive on; DRIVE_TO_SAFE_STOP = leave the motorway at the next safe place and wait for an operator; CONTINUE_AND_MONITOR = an operator may clear the driver to continue carefully. Standard OBD2 codes say little about electric drive systems; most EV faults are manufacturer-specific.

codes.title: Random or multiple cylinder misfire
codes.drivability: Do not drive on if the check-engine light is flashing. Unburnt fuel can overheat and damage the catalytic converter within minutes.
questions_for_driver: Is the check-engine light flashing or steady?
Does the car shake or lose power when you accelerate?
Any smell of fuel or burning?
codes.note: Severity drops to DRIVE_TO_SAFE_STOP if the light is steady and the car runs smoothly.

codes.title: Cylinder 1 misfire detected
codes.drivability: Do not drive on while the check-engine light flashes.
questions_for_driver: Is the check-engine light flashing?
Is the engine shaking at idle?
codes.note: A single-cylinder misfire on a V8 or W12 can feel mild while still damaging the catalyst.

codes.title: Cylinder 2 misfire detected
codes.drivability: Do not drive on while the check-engine light flashes.
questions_for_driver: Is the check-engine light flashing?
Is the engine shaking at idle?

codes.title: Cylinder 3 misfire detected
codes.drivability: Do not drive on while the check-engine light flashes.
questions_for_driver: Is the check-engine light flashing?

codes.title: Cylinder 4 misfire detected
codes.drivability: Do not drive on while the check-engine light flashes.
questions_for_driver: Is the check-engine light flashing?

codes.title: Cylinder 5 misfire detected
codes.drivability: Do not drive on while the check-engine light flashes.
questions_for_driver: Is the check-engine light flashing?

codes.title: Cylinder 6 misfire detected
codes.drivability: Do not drive on while the check-engine light flashes.
questions_for_driver: Is the check-engine light flashing?

codes.title: System too lean (bank 1)
codes.drivability: Usually drivable. An operator may clear the driver to continue if the car runs normally.
questions_for_driver: Does the car hesitate or lose power?
Is the check-engine light steady?

codes.title: System too rich (bank 1)
codes.drivability: Usually drivable. Watch for fuel smell or black smoke.
questions_for_driver: Any smell of fuel?
Any dark smoke from the exhaust?

codes.title: System too lean (bank 2)
codes.drivability: Usually drivable.
questions_for_driver: Does the car hesitate or lose power?

codes.title: Catalyst efficiency below threshold (bank 1)
codes.drivability: Drivable. Not urgent on its own; can follow an earlier misfire.
questions_for_driver: Is the check-engine light steady?
Did the car misfire or shake earlier?

codes.title: Catalyst efficiency below threshold (bank 2)
codes.drivability: Drivable.
questions_for_driver: Is the check-engine light steady?

codes.title: Engine coolant over-temperature
codes.drivability: Stop as soon as it is safe and switch the engine off. Do not open the coolant cap while hot.
questions_for_driver: Is there steam or a sweet smell?
What does the temperature gauge show?
Any coolant on the ground under the car?
codes.note: Driving on can destroy the engine.

codes.title: Coolant temperature below thermostat regulating temperature
codes.drivability: Drivable. Heater may be weak.
questions_for_driver: Is the temperature gauge low?

codes.title: Coolant temperature sensor circuit low
codes.drivability: Usually drivable; the gauge may be wrong, so watch for real overheating signs.
questions_for_driver: Is there steam or a sweet smell?

codes.title: Coolant temperature sensor circuit high
codes.drivability: Usually drivable; the cooling fan may run constantly.
questions_for_driver: Is there steam or a sweet smell?

codes.title: Oil pressure sensor or switch circuit
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place. The car cannot confirm oil pressure, so treat it as possibly low.
questions_for_driver: Is the red oil-can light on?
Any knocking or ticking from the engine?

codes.title: Oil pressure sensor range or performance
codes.drivability: Stop as soon as it is safe and switch the engine off.
questions_for_driver: Is the red oil-can light on?
Any knocking from the engine?

codes.title: Oil pressure sensor circuit low voltage
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place.
questions_for_driver: Is the red oil-can light on?

codes.title: Engine oil pressure too low
codes.drivability: Stop as soon as it is safe and switch the engine off. Driving on can seize the engine.
questions_for_driver: Is the red oil-can light on?
Any oil under the car?

codes.title: System voltage low
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place. The car may lose electrical systems and stall.
questions_for_driver: Is the red battery light on?
Are lights or screens flickering?
codes.note: On electric and hybrid cars this is the 12 V system, which still runs locks, screens and brakes.

codes.title: System voltage high
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place.
questions_for_driver: Is the red battery light on?
Any burning smell?

codes.title: Evaporative emission system small leak
codes.drivability: Drivable.
questions_for_driver: Was the car refuelled recently?
Is the fuel cap clicked shut?

codes.title: Evaporative emission system large leak
codes.drivability: Drivable. Check the fuel cap at the next stop.
common_causes: Fuel cap left off or loose
questions_for_driver: Was the car refuelled recently?
Is the fuel cap on and clicked shut?
codes.note: Very often a loose fuel cap after refuelling.

codes.title: Mass air-flow sensor range or performance
codes.drivability: Usually drivable, possibly with less power.
questions_for_driver: Does the car hesitate when accelerating?

codes.title: Intake air temperature sensor circuit high
codes.drivability: Drivable.
questions_for_driver: Does the car run normally?

codes.title: Crankshaft position sensor circuit
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place. The engine may stall without warning.
questions_for_driver: Has the engine cut out or stuttered?
Does it restart?

codes.title: Camshaft position sensor circuit
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place; the car may run poorly or stall.
questions_for_driver: Is the engine running rough?
Any rattling noise?

codes.title: Vehicle speed sensor malfunction
codes.drivability: Usually drivable; speedometer or gear changes may misbehave.
questions_for_driver: Does the speedometer work?
Are gear changes normal?

codes.title: Transmission control system malfunction
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place. The gearbox may be stuck in a limp-home gear.
common_causes: Gearbox controller has stored its own fault
questions_for_driver: Is the car stuck in one gear?
Any warning message about the gearbox?
codes.note: The gearbox's own code needs a brand tool to read.

codes.title: Transmission input or turbine speed sensor
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place.
questions_for_driver: Are gear changes harsh or missing?

codes.title: Incorrect gear ratio
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place.
questions_for_driver: Does the engine rev without the car speeding up?

codes.title: Torque converter clutch stuck off
codes.drivability: Usually drivable, with higher fuel use.
questions_for_driver: Any shudder at motorway speed?

codes.title: Transmission fluid over-temperature
codes.drivability: Stop as soon as it is safe and let the gearbox cool.
questions_for_driver: Any burning smell?
Is there a gearbox temperature warning?

codes.title: Turbocharger underboost
codes.drivability: The car may be in reduced-power mode. Leave the motorway at the next safe place; do not drive in fast traffic with reduced power.
questions_for_driver: Does the car feel much weaker than before?
Any whistling or hissing noise?

codes.title: Turbocharger overboost
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place.
questions_for_driver: Did the car surge or go into reduced power?

codes.title: Fuel rail pressure too low
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place; the engine may lose power or stall.
questions_for_driver: How much fuel is in the tank?
Is the engine stuttering?

codes.title: Exhaust gas recirculation flow insufficient
codes.drivability: Drivable.
questions_for_driver: Does the car run normally?

codes.title: Particulate filter efficiency below threshold
codes.drivability: Drivable.
questions_for_driver: Is the particulate-filter light on?

codes.title: Particulate filter restriction (ash build-up)
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place; the car may go into reduced power.
questions_for_driver: Is the particulate-filter light on?
Is power reduced?

codes.title: Left front wheel speed sensor circuit
codes.drivability: Normal brakes still work but ABS and stability control may be off. An operator may clear careful driving, with extra distance in wet conditions.
questions_for_driver: Is the ABS or stability light on?
Is the red brake light on as well?
codes.note: If the red brake light is also on, treat it as STOP_NOW.

codes.title: Lost communication with engine control module
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place; several systems may misbehave.
questions_for_driver: Are many warning lights on at once?
Is the engine still running normally?

codes.title: Replace hybrid battery pack
codes.drivability: Leave the motorway at the next safe place; power may be limited.
questions_for_driver: Is there a hybrid system warning message?
Is power reduced?

codes.title: High-voltage system isolation fault
codes.drivability: Stop as soon as it is safe. Do not touch orange high-voltage cables or open the bonnet. Stay out of the car if there is smoke or a burning smell.
common_causes: Moisture or damage in high-voltage wiring
questions_for_driver: Is there smoke, hissing or a burning smell?
What message does the dashboard show?
codes.note: Recovery needs a flatbed and an EV-trained provider.

codes.title: Manufacturer-specific code (placeholder)
codes.drivability: Unknown. Leave the motorway at the next safe place and let an operator decide with the owner.
common_causes: Read with the manufacturer's diagnostic tool
questions_for_driver: What exactly does the dashboard message say?
Can you send a photo of the dashboard?
codes.note: Codes starting P1, P3, B1, C1 or U1 are often manufacturer-specific. A dashboard photo usually tells more than the code.
